The [[Sword of the Kinslayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Chest of Burrows]], which spawns after slaying [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] in [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
Uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Dead Sword]].
